note: What a server answers a registration with, naming a player in the match and the seat they occupy. It shares its command value with the request it answers, which travels the other way, and it is one fixed size. Straight after a request a server sends one answer for every seat, and every one of them carries that request's build and proof back.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The seat playerId holds; where playerId is the client's own, the client takes this seat as its own and goes on.

fields.name: version
fields.note: The build the client said it runs, carried back to it: a server writes the build the request carried.

fields.name: proof
fields.note: The request's proof, carried back: a server writes the proof the request carried.

fields.name: leading
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero. It occupies the same three bytes a request uses.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: Which seat in the match the named player occupies, counted from zero.

fields.name: version
fields.note: The build the client said it runs, carried back to it. Where the answer follows a request it is the number that request carried, 42000315. Where it does not, a server states the build itself.

fields.name: proof
fields.note: The eight bytes a request fills with its proof, carried back. Where the answer follows a request it repeats what that request carried. Where it does not, a server writes zero.

fields.name: trailing
fields.note: Four bytes closing the record. A server writes zero.
